title: Cynbit 4-Pillar Algorithmic Scoring Engine Formulation
content: The Cynbit Scoring Engine evaluates every lead across four mathematically weighted pillars: Firmographic Fit (30%: industry affinity, headcount, revenue scale), Decision-Maker Authority (25%: C-Level, VP, Director vs IC; corporate email validation), Behavioral Intent (25%: pricing visits, 30d site visits, webinars, content downloads), and Budget Urgency (20%: budget threshold and purchase timeline). Normalizes scores to a 0-100 scale and categorizes into Tier 1 (Hot: 80-100), Tier 2 (Warm: 60-79), Tier 3 (Cold: 40-59), and Disqualified (<40). Includes anti-spam guardrails suppressing non-commercial and student submissions.

They store leads and contacts in passive databases, but they cannot autonomously perceive buying intent, calculate multi-factor predictive scores in <5ms, formulate cognitive qualification plans, or generate bespoke, pain-point-specific outreach copy. Cynbit acts as an intelligent cognitive brain sitting directly on top of Salesforce or HubSpot: it listens to incoming webhooks, enriches and qualifies the lead instantly, executes the optimal action, and updates CRM fields in real time without human intervention.
